note: Subject-separated research evaluation. Original videos and per-frame poses are excluded.

dataset.citation: Alam E, Sufian A, Dutta P, Leo M, Hameed IA. GMDCSA24: A dataset for human fall detection in videos. Data in Brief, 2024.
dataset.license: Source repository has MIT LICENSE; participant videos remain local and are not redistributed here.
dataset.split: Subjects 1-2 are development; subjects 3-4 are locked evaluation. Separate from UR Fall.
dataset.labelNote: Clip classes and approximate fall onset are parsed from author CSV files; one fall has no onset timestamp. Event range ends may include recovery/other activities.

training.reserved: GMDCSA-24 subjects 3-4, no detector outputs examined before freeze

limitation: Staged research footage does not establish medical or field reliability; clip-level classification is distinct from event-level accuracy.
